title: Sweet Strawberry E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Introducing our premium CBD E-liquid, a heavenly blend of relaxation and flavour: Sweet Strawberry.
Crafted with care, our CBD E-liquid boasts an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) composition, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. The Sweet Strawberry flavour is a whimsical journey into the sweet nostalgia of Strawberries, providing a luscious and enjoyable cloud with every inhale.
Unwind and treat your senses to the perfect fusion of CBD goodness and sugary delight. Embrace relaxation with each puff of our Sweet Strawberry CBD E-liquid – where tranquillity meets taste in a bottle designed for your ultimate enjoyment.
